name: velo
description: Velo V2 Ask, Plan, and Run modes for Codex — read-only conceptual Q&A, persisted versioned planning with an explicit approval freeze, and frozen-plan execution that commits locally and never pushes.

interface.shortDescription: Conceptual Q&A, approval-gated planning, and frozen-plan runs for Codex (Velo V2 — Ask, Plan, and Run)
interface.longDescription: Velo V2 ships three modes. Ask answers conceptual engineering questions from model knowledge and the current conversation only — it never reads the repository, runs commands, browses, uses connectors, spawns agents, or writes artifacts, and it creates no durable state of any kind. Plan turns a brief into a persisted, versioned plan saved under .velo/ — it may read the repository to plan well, writes only under .velo/, offers explicit approval that freezes the plan version, and never executes the plan. Run consumes only a plan that Plan has frozen and approved: it executes the plan milestone by milestone, gates each milestone on green checks plus one independent review, commits the work locally on the plan's milestone branches, writes only progress marks into the plan, and never pushes, merges, or opens PRs. Auto is a future route no mode starts.
defaultPrompt: Ask Velo a conceptual engineering question
Talk a design trade-off through without touching the repo
Plan a feature into a saved, versioned plan under .velo/
Revise a saved plan and approve it to freeze the version
Run an approved plan milestone by milestone with local commits
